practice.prompt: A 5-m ladder stands with its base 3 m from a wall. How high does it reach? Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A 10-m ramp rises at 30° above horizontal. Find its vertical rise. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A right-triangle roof has horizontal run 8 m and pitch 45°. Find the vertical rise. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A slope rises 12 m over a horizontal run of 20 m. Find its angle with horizontal in degrees. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A tree casts an 18-m shadow when the sun's elevation is 35°. Find the tree height. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A 15-m ramp makes 20° with ground. Find its vertical rise. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A ladder makes 60° with ground and reaches 9 m vertically. Find ladder length. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A 25-m cable is stretched at 40° above horizontal. Find its horizontal reach. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A 20-m building is viewed at 32° elevation from level ground. Find observer distance from its base. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A wheelchair ramp rises 5 units over a 12-unit horizontal run. Find its incline angle. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A 13-m support cable reaches a point 5 m above ground. Find horizontal distance from its anchor. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A hillside path slopes 60 m at 12° above horizontal. Find the elevation gain. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A tower is observed from 50 m away at 25° elevation. Find tower height assuming eye level is ground level. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A drone is 100 m above level ground and 120 m away in a straight line from an observer. Find horizontal separation. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A boat travels 15 km at 30° north of east. Find its eastward displacement. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A tower is 30 m high. From 40 m and 70 m away, find the difference between the two angles of elevation. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
An observer's eyes are 1.7 m high, 50 m from a tower, with 38° elevation to the top. Find total tower height. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A path climbs 12 m along a 35° slope, then 9 m along a 25° slope. Find total vertical gain. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.

test.prompt: A building casts a 10-m shadow at 45° sun elevation. Find its height. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A cable of length 18 m makes 30° above horizontal. Find horizontal reach. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A ladder reaches 14 m vertically at a 40° ground angle. Find ladder length. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A roof rises 9 ft over a 16-ft run. Find its pitch angle. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
A surveyor moves 20 m at 35° above east then 15 m at 60° above east. Find total eastward distance. Round your answer to the nearest hundredth.
